4.source: relic set 109 (Band of Sizzling Thunder), 4-piece ability Ability51091: "When the wearer uses their Skill, increases the wearer's ATK by #1[i]% for #2[i] turn(s)." param = [0.2, 1]
4.note: #1[i] -> percent = 0.2 (20% ATK), #2[i] -> turns = 1. 'actor == self' is the 'the wearer uses' half. The other half -- 'their Skill' and NOT their Ultimate or their Basic ATK -- needs no condition here: the emitter splits the three in-battle casts (SkillExecutor.broadcastSkillCast switches on the parsed SkillCategory, the only place that can tell them apart, because the condition DSL has no variable for the kind of cast). ⚠ Until 2026-09-27 that split was two-way ('ultimate vs everything else'), so this set was also granting its ATK buff on 普攻 -- found while authoring Robin's 模进乐段, which has the same 施放战技时 wording; UltCastTriggerTest.basicAttackFiresBasicAttackAndNotSkillCast pins it now. Timing: the cast event is fired after the skill's damage is settled, so the ATK buff applies from the next settlement on.
